before_block_e3_start: Vectorised agent-based simulation. 500,000 synthetic agents, 10 years. Age, mobile money, urban residence and the starting TIN status are a weighted resample of real FinScope Tanzania 2023 respondents' attributes (aggregate cells, data/processed/agent_cells.json) with the real-data targeting model's predicted propensities; income (ILFS 2024 earnings by age band) and trust and morale (Afrobarometer Round 8 by age band and urban/rural) are drawn from aggregate survey cell distributions. Compliance probability = f(trust, morale, income, MM). Interventions applied annually. Random seed: 42 for reproducibility.
after_block_e3: Vectorised agent-based simulation. 500,000 synthetic agents, 10 years. Age, mobile money, urban residence and the starting TIN status are a weighted resample of real FinScope Tanzania 2023 respondents' attributes (aggregate cells, data/processed/agent_cells.json) with the real-data targeting model's predicted propensities; income (ILFS 2024 earnings by age band) and trust and morale (Afrobarometer Round 8 by age band and urban/rural) are drawn from aggregate survey cell distributions. Yearly registration probability of a non-registered agent = conversion_rate x clip(trust, morale, income-rank and mobile-money terms + intercept); trust and morale are the agent's survey-based values and do not evolve (Block E3.1). Interventions multiply the agent's yearly registration odds by the tax-morale model's odds ratios (the same mechanism as Fig 5.1). Random seed: 42 for reproducibility.
